_note: Every user-facing string in Couch to Hour. Edit values freely; keep keys and {placeholders} intact. DEBUG-only developer UI is not in here. See Copy.swift.

mode.title: How do you want to run this?
mode.body: You can change this later in Settings.
mode.threeDayBody: Three sessions a week on set days, a rest day between each. We fill in your calendar.
mode.freeBody: Work through the weeks at your own pace. No schedule, no calendar.

startingWeek.title: Where do you want to start?
startingWeek.body: Week 1 assumes you're starting from scratch. Skip ahead if you already run.

startWeekday.title: Which day does your week start?
startWeekday.body: Sessions land on this day and every second day after, resetting each week.

philosophy.title: This isn't a race.
philosophy.body1: Run at a pace where you could still hold a conversation. If you can't, slow down — that's the whole method, not a failure.
philosophy.body2: The plan measures time spent running, never distance or speed. Miss a day and nothing breaks; the app just asks what you want to do next.

restDay.title: Rest day
restDay.body: Nothing scheduled. See you on your next session day.

planComplete.title: Plan complete
planComplete.body: You went from the couch to a full hour. That's the whole thing.

missed.title: You missed Week {week} · Day {day}
missed.body: Do it now, or pick up with today's session. No rush either way.

timer.runCaption: Conversation pace — if you can't talk, ease off.
timer.walkCaption: Walk it out, catch your breath.

endConfirm.title: End the session?
endConfirm.body: It won't be marked done, and your progress is discarded.

postWorkout.title: How did that feel?
postWorkout.body: 1 is easy, 10 is all out. It just helps you look back later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dimOtherAudioCaption: Timer cues always play alongside your music, even on silent. When on, the music dips briefly so each click is easy to hear.

reset.footerCaption: Deletes your completed sessions and schedule.
reset.alertBody: Deletes your completed sessions and schedule. This can't be undone.
